snippet.title: KNOSSOS trailer 2017
snippet.description:
Play KNOSSOS at the Reversed Festival 2017, Museumsquartier,Vienna!

KNOSSOS is a up to 8 player local multiplayer brawler set in ancient greek on the island of knosses.. expect it has shotguns and spacerays as powerups.
Play 4 different gamemodes!
-Minotaur (DM but best player gets to be a monster)
-Flood (LMS after the flood gets activated)
-Achilles (CTF but no teams)
-Ball (think Bloodball meets Rocket Leage)

http://www.reversed.at/
www.ancient-pixel.com
@AncientPixel_AP
